task: Predict PIK3CA mutation status in colon adenocarcinoma. Classes: negative vs. positive. On H&E, subtle differences may include mucinous differentiation, serrated-like architecture, tumor heterogeneity, and inflammatory stromal patterns, although separation is limited on routine morphology alone.

classes.0: PIK3CA-negative tumor lacking distinctive morphology suggestive of serrated or mucin-rich differentiation.
classes.1: PIK3CA-positive tumor with possible mucinous change, serrated-like glandular architecture, and heterogeneous growth patterns.
